source.title: Cambridge B1 Preliminary for Schools Trainer · Exam Practice
source.selection: B1+–B2 useful vocabulary appearing on original Exam Practice pages; examples and explanations created for learning.

words.definition: connected with the physical features of the Earth
words.example: The website explains geographical features of Europe.
words.cloze: The website explains ________ features of Europe.

words.definition: a place that someone travels to
words.example: Sweden was our chosen holiday destination.
words.cloze: Sweden was our chosen holiday ________.

words.definition: to change how you act to suit new conditions
words.example: People adapt to extremely cold climates in different ways.
words.cloze: People ________ to extremely cold climates in different ways.

words.definition: the usual weather conditions in an area
words.example: The climate in northern Sweden is cold in winter.
words.cloze: The ________ in northern Sweden is cold in winter.

words.definition: very great or unusual in degree
words.example: They learned how people survive extreme temperatures.
words.cloze: They learned how people survive ________ temperatures.

words.definition: the pointed top of a mountain
words.example: Snow covered the highest mountain peak.
words.cloze: Snow covered the highest mountain ________.

words.definition: near and around a particular place
words.example: We watched birds in the surrounding forest.
words.cloze: We watched birds in the ________ forest.

words.definition: one of the largest land areas of the Earth
words.example: Africa is a continent with many different climates.
words.cloze: Africa is a ________ with many different climates.

words.definition: skiing across open land rather than down steep slopes
words.example: We tried cross-country skiing during our holiday.
words.cloze: We tried ________ during our holiday.

words.definition: rising or falling sharply
words.example: The mountain path was too steep for beginners.
words.cloze: The mountain path was too ________ for beginners.

words.definition: to register to take part in an activity
words.example: My mum and I decided to sign up for the trip.
words.cloze: My mum and I decided to ________ for the trip.

words.definition: making you feel calm and rested
words.example: Staying away from the internet was surprisingly relaxing.
words.cloze: Staying away from the internet was surprisingly ________.

words.definition: a report of what the weather will be like
words.example: The forecast said we would have sunshine all week.
words.cloze: The ________ said we would have sunshine all week.

words.definition: very pleased and happy
words.example: I was delighted to see the Northern Lights.
words.cloze: I was ________ to see the Northern Lights.

words.definition: a large bag carried on the back
words.example: My heavy rucksack was full of warm clothes.
words.cloze: My heavy ________ was full of warm clothes.

words.definition: covered in ice or changed into ice
words.example: We crossed a frozen lake on our skis.
words.cloze: We crossed a ________ lake on our skis.

words.definition: extremely tired
words.example: After skiing for hours, we were exhausted.
words.cloze: After skiing for hours, we were ________.

words.definition: relating to a paid job requiring special skills
words.example: He became a professional piano builder.
words.cloze: He became a ________ piano builder.

words.definition: a thin piece of metal used in equipment
words.example: The piano makes a sound when its wire is struck.
words.cloze: The piano makes a sound when its ________ is struck.

words.definition: to move something from one place to another
words.example: They needed help to transfer the giant piano.
words.cloze: They needed help to ________ the giant piano.

words.definition: extremely well
words.example: The unusual instrument still performs brilliantly.
words.cloze: The unusual instrument still performs ________.

words.definition: difficult because there are many connected parts
words.example: The raven solved a complicated problem to find food.
words.cloze: The raven solved a ________ problem to find food.

words.definition: to do a task, plan or experiment
words.example: Scientists carry out experiments with clever birds.
words.cloze: Scientists ________ experiments with clever birds.

words.definition: a scientific test to discover or prove something
words.example: The birds learned a new skill during the experiment.
words.cloze: The birds learned a new skill during the ________.
